# Every route a local instance answers, as the pattern given to the mux, sorted.
#
# TestDBLocalModeUnchanged compares this list with the routes of a server started with no setting.
# A route added for every instance is added here in the same pull request, where a reviewer sees
# it. A route that belongs to federation is registered only in a mode that federates and never
# appears here: a deployment that sets nothing new must answer exactly what it answered before.
